evidence.text: An Act to regulate and amend the Law respecting the Salmon Fisheries of Scotland.

accepted_sources.notes:
Review decision: Accepted from needs_human_review where title clearly concerns fish/fisheries.

AI triage rationale: An Act to regulate and amend the Law respecting the Salmon Fisheries of Scotland. (1862): Matched on 'fish reared from roe, fish roe' (weak terms per triage guidance). Title clearly concerns salmon fisheries. Salmon is a fish species within the category's scope (freshwater fish, commercial fishing, fish-derived food/feed products). The title states the Act regulates salmon fisheries, which may include commercial catching, netting, sale, management, fishing rights, close seasons, gear restrictions, or enforcement. However, 19th-century salmon-fishery Acts often focused primarily on conservation, protection of spawning grounds, close seasons, illegal fishing methods, and sporting/proprietary fishing rights, with commercial catching, trade, marketing or food-production regulation secondary or absent. The match on 'fish reared from roe, fish roe' suggests the Act may contain provisions on salmon hatcheries, stocking, or roe protection — which would be in scope if linked to commercial aquaculture, farmed fish or production, but out of scope if the sole purpose is conservation, biodiversity or sporting-fishery stock enhancement. The triage guidance notes 'Fisheries-management and mixed conservation/fisheries sources are in scope when they govern commercial catching, fish stocks, quotas/TACs, fishing opportunities, fishing effort, landings, gear restrictions, vessel licensing or monitoring, fisheries enforcement, or market supply or sale' and 'Do not exclude fisheries-management sources merely because they contain conservation language if the operative mechanism regulates commercial catching.' Without the full text or operative provisions, it is uncertain whether this Act materially regulates commercial salmon catching, landings, trade, processing or sale, or whether it is primarily a conservation/sporting-fishery instrument with no material commercial food/feed/production controls. Needs human legal review to determine scope and materiality. Conservative: 'uncertain' relevance, 'needs_human_review' priority, 'medium' confidence.
